items.title: Babe Stovall Interview, 1974-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You ever hear of fast-a-poole, Tony? Fast-a-poole? Spanish? Never heard of Spanish, dude.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . I know it's all that fun. I'm tuned to different ways, you know. I'm playing different ways. But I don't know one chord, one note, and I can't read something. It's never good.
You ever hear of fast-a-poole, Tony? Fast-a-poole? Spanish? Never heard of Spanish, dude.

I think I read somewhere that you came to New Orleans to live in 1963. Was that? Yeah. So was that the year you came here? Yeah. Is your family, are all your brothers and sisters still alive? Your family? No.
